subject: Reserved words
notes: kb/Work PB2024 landed (re-verdicted from PARTIAL; claimed first by PB715, registrar 15c). Rule: 'Keywords. Within each format, such words are uppercase and underlined' under the clause head 'A required word is a word whose presence is required when the format in which the word appears is used' (cite.py --check 8.3.2.4.2 -> OK §8.3.2.4.2 1) / Required words); §5.2.2 makes a keyword required 'subject to the conventions specified in 5.2.6' (OK §5.2.2), and only brackets (§5.2.6.2) and choice indicators (§5.2.6.4) make a portion omissible. The rule is realized distributively by every parser rule that writes an underlined word as a non-optional token, and by the binder screens that refuse an omission the grammar keeps optional to NAME it (StatementValidation.ScreenOmittedRequiredPhrase, COBOL1850). It is now VERIFIED MECHANICALLY: scripts/spec/audit_grammar_optional_words.py's inverse class `required-word` joins every grammar token an alternative lets be omitted (`?`/`*`, an optional group or rule) to the measured option structure of all 322 printed general formats (scripts/spec/figure_options.py: each word with the brackets, choice indicators and braces that hold it) and reports one the format demands wherever a word the alternative demands is written; its `repeated-word` class does the same for a `+`/`*` the format's ellipses do not license (§5.2.7). Measured 2026-10-29: 0 undecided candidates in either class; the decided ones name the later phase in their rule (`audit:required-word FROM decided-by ArithmeticBinder.BindSubtract`, `END-SEND decided-by DeclinedFacilityBinder.ScreenSendRequiredPhrases`; `audit:repeated-word` for CONTROL's FINAL, the PAGE clause's phrases and OCCURS DYNAMIC's phrases). A control run that re-introduced PB755's `LOCK ON?`, PB756's `ALTERNATE RECORD?` and PB1183's `unstringIntoPhrase+` reported all three. The audit's first full run found one real under-rejection, SEND's unbracketed END-SEND (and, read on the same page, Format 1's RETURNING for a literal-1 operand), now refused with COBOL1850 (pb2024-send-* witnesses). Limits, stated: the audit measures the licensed PDF and so runs in no gate (CI has no specs-private); it judges at construct granularity and under-reports where one word plays two roles; compiler directives (§7.3) are the preprocessor's and not joined. [editions as adjudicated: 85, 2002, 2014, 2023 (the required-word/keyword notation is edition-independent; §8.3.2.4.2 as printed in 2023)]
